worker-pool-native-protocol.comparison: JavaScript pool owns worker lifetime/dispatch ordinal/cancellation, not Rust product/cache identity or GPU renderer. GenerationDecision reuse/generate and GeneratedDelivery job+bytes are explicit wire products; candidate exact serialized Rust address is preserved at decision and receive, dispatch safeinteger checked and matched separately. Initialization/generation status, elapsed milliseconds and processor capacity have different scopes; no raw integer alias with source Seed or asset ID. Native Uint8Array/ArrayBuffer/postMessage ports legitimately serialize opaque Rust addresses and dependencies; no competing Rust recipe schema here. Local string phase/status is protocol vocabulary for later string/enum lens, not proof of duplicate owner without counterpart contract.
worker-pool-native-protocol.disposition: Coherent worker transport ownership with distinct job address and dispatch identity.

runtime-body-gltf-native-ingress.comparison: CanonicalBody groups shared RuntimeBody with morph targets/names and FittingRig extracted from same native glTF source. Native attributes/indices are projected into canonical PackedRigSkin/RigJointName/RigJointTable; zero-padding4 to8 is native ABI adaptation, not duplicate independent joint ID. Joint-name/global bind-state table count correlation checked; count alone not same-asset provenance certification. Raw morph names are external glTF vocabulary, not canonical rig joint names. Geometry chart calculations are true numerical ports and original fixture no new generated source. Existing F032 canonical packing policy graph remains distinct.
runtime-body-gltf-native-ingress.disposition: Correct native glTF adaptation into canonical rig owners and explicit runtime UV domain.

strategic-render-status-projection.comparison: Status is browser benchmark/readiness output over actual RetainedScene/StrategicView, character/texture/equipment/pipeline caches; it is not stored gameplay authority. SceneInstallationReady deliberately omits final equipment while SceneAssetsReady includes it, and final ready adds settled render frames/cache; these flags are different pipeline predicates, not duplicate identical accepted token by type name. Counters and revision are telemetry native JSON values, environment daylight Vec4 is shader diagnostic product. Shared procedural catalogue used directly; no parallel texture identity roster. Renderer status error string joins actual lower errors at output only. Actual readiness scheduling/derived caches remain separate redundancy lens, not blanket invariant from resource names.
strategic-render-status-projection.disposition: Legitimate phase-specific readiness and telemetry projection, no new ownership move.

architectural-floor-to-scene-datum.comparison: GeneratedBuilding::geometry_datum consumes actual architectural CollisionBounds centre, placement plan projection and signed scene SupportElevation through ArchitecturalFloorDatum::collision_centre; resulting CollisionCentreDatum/native_transform is explicit frame/datum change. architectural-floor-to-scene-datum.disposition: Coherent explicit architectural floor versus collision-centre datum transformation.
